# NumWorks third-party provenance

WebTILP vendors the following independently MIT-licensed dependencies. No code
from the AGPL-licensed Upsilon Workshop application is included.

## Upsilon.js

- Repository: <https://github.com/Yaya-Cout/Upsilon.js>
- Revision: `aeb3fd281ee973f3ddff29559055eee7ac53cae0`
- Package version: `1.5.0`
- Selection reason: this is the exact revision pinned by
  Yaya-Cout/Upsilon-Workshop's working `master-vite` dependency lock. It
  includes UTF-8 storage support and the Epsilon 24+ alternate-interface fixes.
- Vendored files: `index.js`, `Numworks.js`, `Storage.js`, `Recovery.js`,
  `package.json`, and `LICENSE`

Local integration change: the two CommonJS `require("webdfu")` calls point to
the adjacent vendored `../webdfu` directory. No protocol behavior is changed.

## WebDFU

- Repository: <https://github.com/M4xi1m3/webdfu>
- npm package: `webdfu@1.0.5`
- npm integrity:
  `sha512-aZ7FwAq5qCUMas6wpkISQzb+DuE+9dCdpIWejZuQGzsNqr0UlaVCvz4oezoGDoGtTKmRaXjpUlTBung+lGAHVQ==`
- Vendored files: `index.js`, `DFU.js`, `DFUse.js`, `package.json`, and
  `LICENSE`

The final browser artifact is generated by Bun from
`numworks_backend_entry.mjs`. It contains both dependencies and the WebTILP
adapter; neither dependency is loaded from a CDN at runtime.
